English.Char_Desc_450: Snooker Pro is a free snooker game for Windows. Play a full frame on a full-size table with 15 reds and 6 colours, realistic ball physics with top, back and side spin, an aim guide, official scoring and fouls, and cue-ball-in-hand in the D. English.Char_Desc_2000:
Snooker Pro is a free snooker game for Windows that brings the full game to your desktop. Play frames on a full-size table with 15 reds and 6 colours, six pockets, and realistic ball physics including top spin, back spin and side spin. A smooth shaded 2D table, cue stick animation, power meter, aim guide and sound effects make every shot easy to read.
Features: - Official snooker scoring: pot a red then a colour, then the colours in order from yellow to black - Fouls detected automatically: cue ball potted, no ball hit, wrong ball hit first, wrong ball potted (minimum 4 points to the opponent) - Colours respotted correctly; cue ball in hand in the D after a foul - Play against the computer on Easy, Medium or Hard, or play a friend on the same computer - Spin control: drag a dot on the spin ball for follow, screw back and side spin; fine aim with Shift or the arrow keys - Scoreboard with current break, frames won and best break; concede option and in-game help - Single small executable, no installation, no extra runtime files
Controls: aim with the mouse, hold the left mouse button (or Space) to charge power and release to shoot.
Snooker Pro is made by Transys, Pakistan, with CEO/VP Faiz ul Haque Zeya.
